ClsFunction.Body:
<DisplayName("نوسازی")> Public Function Nosazi() As ClsRayvarzMessageContract Dim param = Info8.GetAccountingDocCreateParameter() Dim result = ClsAccounting.Save(param) Return result End Function
Public Function iNcOME() As ClsRayvarzMessageContract Dim param = Info8.GetAccountingDocCreateParameter() Dim result = ClsAccounting.Save(param) Return result End Function
Public Function iNcOMEOragh() As ClsRayvarzMessageContract Return iNcOME() End Function
Public Function iNcOMESeprdeh() As ClsRayvarzMessageContract Return iNcOME() End Function
Public Function iNcOMEEshghal() As ClsRayvarzMessageContract Return iNcOME() End Function
Public Function Run() As ClsRayvarzMessageContract If Biz.Communication.DutyFicheResultList.Count > 0 Then Return Nosazi() ElseIf Biz.Communication.IncomeFicheResultList.Count > 0 Then Return iNcOME() End If End Function
